description: ONLY after explicit approval: recheck complete readiness, submit once and retain an asynchronous receipt without assuming completion.

notChecked: Gen2 first refresh, loaded/fresh data, consumers and visuals
source credentials, grants, storage/security modes and naming parity

notes: In-place replacement is irreversible. The approval flag never bypasses fresh all-ready assessment. Sender makes one POST, including on 401/429/5xx. Accepted/malformed-body/network-unknown receipts must not be resubmitted. follow-upgrade reads the same saved scope/operation; synchronous verified results are nested under result. Per-item partial success returns non-zero with preserved results, not automatic retry approval.

query_examples.description: Inspect acknowledgement and identity, not completion.
Inspect scoped failures; isRetriable is not authorization.
